sources.title: Santé publique France — departmental vaccination coverage
sources.cadence: Periodic published estimates; not a live feed
sources.limitation: Reimbursement-derived estimate; some vaccinations are not captured; year denotes campaign start; missing values are not zero.

sources.title: SPF Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes 2025–26 respiratory season bulletin
sources.period: 2025–26; coverage data through 28 February 2026; published 1 October 2026
sources.purpose: National VCR 56.7%; prior season 53.7%; policy-target context
sources.limitation: Regional enhanced coverage is combined Efluelda/Fluad, not Efluelda share.

sources.title: IQVIA public pharmacy flu campaign dataset
sources.purpose: Historical dispensing and pharmacy administration trajectories
sources.limitation: Extrapolated panel; no brand or departmental detail; pharmacy administrations exclude other vaccinators. Publisher geography wording is inconsistent, so verify DROM inclusion before extending beyond metropolitan France.

sources.title: Assurance Maladie Medic’AM
sources.limitation: Reimbursed packs by reimbursement date, not administered doses; no age/local geography. Map pack size before dose calculations; inpatient and hospital-retrocession dispensing excluded.

sources.title: HAS — Efluelda and Fluad in vaccination strategy for adults aged 65+
sources.purpose: Recommendation and interpretation of category adoption
sources.limitation: Equivalent positioning of high-dose and adjuvanted vaccines; standard-dose vaccines remain usable; no preference between Efluelda and Fluad.

sources.title: Assurance Maladie — 2026–27 vaccination campaign
sources.limitation: Distinguish vaccine reimbursement, administration reimbursement, authorisation and recommendation.

sources.title: Sanofi pharmacy vaccination resources
sources.purpose: Precedent for pharmacy education and 65+ materials
sources.limitation: Public materials do not establish local deployment, exposure or effectiveness.

sources.title: Sanofi — community flu prevention with EmerJean
sources.limitation: Not evidence that our featured departments have the same activity or barriers.

sources.title: Sanofi FLUNITY-HD evidence announcement
sources.purpose: Example of clinical/RWE context in the interpretive knowledge base
sources.limitation: High-dose versus standard-dose evidence; not a local intervention effect or Efluelda-versus-Fluad superiority claim. No efficacy arithmetic is used in the demo.

sources.title: GERS data capability
sources.cadence: Daily collection documented; licensed delivery cadence and lag unconfirmed
sources.purpose: Potential product, supply and sales enrichment
sources.limitation: No GERS data are included. Simulated fortnightly refresh does not claim Sanofi access.

sources.title: INSEE population estimates
sources.limitation: Population fields in this demonstrator are synthetic, not INSEE figures.

sources.title: DREES local access to health professionals
sources.limitation: Demo access scores are synthetic; do not claim an actual DREES join.

sources.title: Demonstration model and clusters
sources.purpose: Explain clustering, expected uptake and potential drivers
sources.limitation: Profiles are assigned by an authored rule using public coverage, the age profile and area type, with designed driver scores. Not a trained or validated model; scores are not causal effects or feature importance.

sources.title: Demonstration product and availability feed
sources.cadence: Fortnightly assumption; 3-day reporting lag in prepared snapshots
sources.limitation: Not GERS, IQVIA or Sanofi actual data.

sources.title: Demonstration engagement and intervention log
sources.limitation: No real deployment or approved spending; comparative signals are not causal estimates.

sources.limitation: Not a Sanofi internal document or approved policy.
